diff --git a/db/dev_seeds/projekts.rb b/db/dev_seeds/projekts.rb
index 47abb80..ebba2f2 100644
--- a/db/dev_seeds/projekts.rb
+++ b/db/dev_seeds/projekts.rb
@@ -17,5 +17,14 @@ section "Creating Projekts" do
     )
     projekt.projekt_settings.find_by(key: 'projekt_feature.main.activate').update(value: 'active')
     projekt.projekt_settings.find_by(key: 'projekt_feature.general.show_in_navigation').update(value: 'active')
+
+    # Each resource in the dev seeds is attached to a phase, so create one
+    # phase of every resource type used by the later seed sections.
+    projekt.projekt_phases.create!(type: 'ProjektPhase::CommentPhase', active: true)
+    projekt.projekt_phases.create!(type: 'ProjektPhase::DebatePhase', active: true)
+    projekt.projekt_phases.create!(type: 'ProjektPhase::ProposalPhase', active: true)
+    projekt.projekt_phases.create!(type: 'ProjektPhase::VotingPhase', active: true)
+    projekt.projekt_phases.create!(type: 'ProjektPhase::BudgetPhase', active: true)
+    projekt.projekt_phases.create!(type: 'ProjektPhase::LegislationPhase', active: true)
   end
 end
